chunks: And from him (Al-Shaykh) from Ali ibn al-Nu'man from Ibn Muskhan from Mansur ibn Hazim who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who marries a woman and dies before consummating the marriage with her. He said: 'She is entitled to her full dowry, and she inherits him, and she observes a waiting period of four months and ten days, like the waiting period of a woman whose husband dies.' As for what has been narrated in the reports that she is entitled to half the dowry, such as what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Muslim and Ubayd ibn Zur'arah and Al-Halabi (whose mention preceded) and what was narrated by...
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on dowry and inheritance if a husband dies before consummating the marriage?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Tusi's *Tahdhib* clarifies the fiqh of 'death before consummation,' affirming that the wife receives full mahr, inheritance rights, and the extended widow's iddah of four months and ten days. It addresses the scholarly debate regarding the discrepancy between this ruling and other reports citing only half the mahr, highlighting the methodological approach to reconciling apparent contradictions in hadith literature. This ruling is pivotal in Shia jurisprudence for determining the financial and social status of the widow in cases of pre-consummation death.
